Priya Raman
Senior Software Engineer

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 6 years building Java and Spring Boot services in fintech. Led the migration of a monolithic payments system to event-driven microservices on Kafka.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer, FinFlow Payments (2021-03 to present)
- Led the decomposition of the payments monolith into 9 Spring Boot microservices communicating over Apache Kafka.
- Designed idempotent payment-capture consumers with an outbox pattern, cutting duplicate charges to zero.
- Reduced p99 authorisation latency from 480 ms to 140 ms by tuning PostgreSQL indexes and HikariCP pools.
- On-call lead for the payments domain; ran 12 incident post-mortems.

Software Engineer, Ledgerly (2018-07 to 2021-02)
- Built REST APIs in Java 11 and Spring Boot for a double-entry ledger used by 200 merchants.
- Containerised services with Docker and deployed to Kubernetes using Helm.
- Wrote reconciliation jobs that matched bank settlement files against internal ledger entries.

PROJECTS
Kafka Replay Tool: Java, Spring Boot, Kafka Streams. CLI that replays dead-lettered events with schema validation.
Rate Limiter Service: Java, Redis. Token-bucket rate limiter shared by 30 internal services.

SKILLS
Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, REST, Microservices, JUnit, Git

EDUCATION

CERTIFICATIONS
